purpose: Repair only the midpoint/axis evidence integration proposal. The Local-Group peak targets, likelihood sigma, all 256 CF4 parents, exact projection contract, and CF4 gates remain unchanged.

information_firewall.V1_role: Development evidence used only to freeze the new bank sizes and proposal family.
adaptation_fitter_input: parent-uniform logmeanexp of log_Z_peak over all 256 parents
adaptation_fitter_forbidden_input: top parent or selected parent information

target_density.midpoint_prior: The unchanged V8 three-dimensional diagonal-normal target prior p(q).
target_density.axis_prior: u(a)=1/(4*pi) on S2, with a and -a physically equivalent.

adaptation_bank.proposal: g_A(q,a)=g_V1(q) u(a), where g_V1 is the sealed equal-weight prior-plus-transport midpoint Gaussian mixture.
adaptation_bank.geometry_log_weight: logmeanexp_j(log Z_ji) + log pi0(q_i,a_i) - log g_A(q_i,a_i)
adaptation_bank.parent_marginalization: Every parent has exactly weight 1/256 before geometry fitting.

gate.four_fold_CV_rule: fold=draw_index mod 4; fit on the other three folds
gate.holdout_delta: sum of holdout-normalized omega_i times log[h_minus_fold(q_i,a_i)/pi0(q_i,a_i)]

fallback.CV_or_EM_failure_action: Stop for proposal-family redesign; do not alter K, floors, kappa cap, targets, or sigma after reading results.

adaptive_component_density.joint_coupling: The midpoint and antipodal axis share only the same component index k; no regression or parent-conditioned term is allowed.

axis_density.sampling: Draw sign s uniformly from {-1,+1}, then draw vMF(s*nu,kappa). For U,V uniform, w=1+log(U+(1-U)*exp(-2*kappa))/kappa and phi=2*pi*V; for kappa=0 use w=2*U-1.

weighted_EM.seed_rule: SeedSequence(master_seed, spawn_key=(fold_id,restart_id)); fold_id 0..3 for CV and 4 for the full fit.

initialization.initial_alpha_mu_covariance: weighted hard-assignment moments with covariance eigenvalue clipping
initialization.initial_axis: principal eigenvector of sum_i omega_i a_i a_i^T in the assigned group
initialization.axis_sign: Make the coordinate having the largest absolute value positive; coordinate-index ties use the lowest index.

M_step.axis_resultant: R_k=sum_i omega_i tau_ik m_ik a_i / sum_i omega_i tau_ik
M_step.axis_direction: nu_k=R_k/norm(R_k), with the frozen axis-sign convention
M_step.kappa_solver: Bisection on [0,20] with absolute tolerance 1e-12; clip to 20 when the target exceeds the value at 20.

weighted_EM.convergence: Relative objective increase <=1e-8 for five consecutive iterations.
weighted_EM.empty_component_failure: Fail the restart if N_k<1e-4 or component effective membership<4.
weighted_EM.selection: Among converged restarts choose maximum L; ties within 1e-12 choose the lowest restart number.

final_proposal.sampling: First draw a Bernoulli(0.5). Base branch draws q from p and a from u. Adaptive branch draws k from alpha, q from its full Gaussian, and a from its antipodal axis kernel.
final_proposal.parent_geometry_log_weight: log Z_ji + log p(q_i)+log u(a_i)-log g_F(q_i,a_i)

final_bank.failure_action: If an MC gate fails, do not train on the final bank and stop. Only after all MC gates pass may a parent-support or CF4 gate failure be interpreted as physical tension.

storage.result_JSON: Lineage, proposal, summaries, gates, and per-parent aggregates only.
storage.numeric_artifact: Immutable compact arrays including float64 log_Z_peak[parent,draw], float64 log_importance[parent,draw], midpoint q, axis a, proposal component and branch, and geometry normalization terms.

decision_on_final_pass: Authorize only the design of a separately frozen conditional-field bank. Seed promotion, candidate screening, PM, halo finding, zoom masks, and RAMSES remain unauthorized.
